summary_en: Major porphyry Cu-Mo deposit in northern Chile. Phase 2 expansion (QB2) commissioned in 2023.
Supergene-enriched porphyry Cu deposit adjacent to Escondida. Heap leach SX-EW operation.
Large-tonnage low-grade porphyry Cu-Mo-Au deposit. One of Chile's newest major mines.
Porphyry Cu-Au deposit complex including Esperanza and Tesoro pits. Large SX-EW operation.
Low-grade porphyry Cu-Mo deposit. Heap leach operation producing copper cathodes.
High-arsenic porphyry Cu deposit near Chuquicamata. Codelco's newest mine with roasting plant.
Structurally controlled porphyry Cu deposit. One of Chile's oldest operating mines.
Porphyry Cu-Au deposit with supergene enrichment. Produces copper concentrate and cathodes.
Large-tonnage porphyry Cu-Mo deposit in the Atacama region. High altitude operation.
IOCG-style Cu-Au deposit. Underground mine exploiting mantos and veins.
Exotic copper deposit with atacamite and chrysocolla mineralization. SX-EW cathode production.
Small porphyry Cu-Au deposit. Past-producing open pit mine.
Historic Cu-Ag mining district. Stratabound mantos and veins in Jurassic volcanic rocks. Production ceased.
IOCG-style Fe-Cu deposit in the Chilean Iron Belt. Produces copper concentrate and iron ore.
Small porphyry Cu deposit. Exotic copper mineralization. Past-producing.
Fe-Cu IOCG deposit in the Chilean Iron Belt. Magnetite-rich with copper credits.
Small porphyry Cu deposit. Heap leach operation producing copper cathodes.
IOCG-style Cu-Au deposit under development. Note: distinct from Mantoverde to the south.
Small porphyry Cu-Mo deposit. Past-producing open pit.
Undeveloped porphyry Cu-Au-Mo deposit. Part of NuevaUnion project with El Morro.
